description: Eerste Van Swindenstraat 391-401 (1882, strip 2022-01-12, gridded 40 px/m): plain red-brown brick, 3 axes on 5.0 m, shop ground to 3.0 m, three upper storeys of 2.85 m, 1.0 x 1.9 m cambered sash windows with white frames and sills, cream cornice with panelled frieze (11.1-12.2 m), a dark slate mansard behind it with skylights and one pointed wooden dormer per house (1.5 m wide, ridge 14.0 m, iron finial)

roof.evidence: Eerste Van Swindenstraat 391-401, 2022-01-12 strip: a dark slate mansard 1.0 m high behind the cornice (12.2-13.2 m) with skylights beside the dormer
